title: Top Layer-1 Altcoins to Watch: Why Users ≠ Price Growth 📉🚀 #crypto #altcoins
description:
Description:
Adoption is the "holy grail" of crypto, but does more users always mean a higher price? 🧐

In today’s video, we’re looking at the five Layer-1 blockchains dominating the market in April 2026. While BNB Chain and TRON are seeing massive traffic, some newer chains like Sei are proving that high usage doesn't always lead to a green candle. We strip away the jargon to help you understand the difference between a busy network and a good investment.

In this video, we cover:
✅ The Top 5 Leaderboard: Why BNB Chain is crushing it with 4.3M users.
✅ The Ethereum Shift: Why the "King of DeFi" isn't in the top 5 for activity right now.
✅ Solana & NEAR: Can these mid-tier giants turn user growth into a $100+ price tag?
✅ The Sei Paradox: Why millions of users can still lead to a price drop.

At DeFi Planet, we help you follow the data, not just the hype.

Which ecosystem are you betting on this month? Drop your thoughts in the comments! 👇

🕒 Timestamps:
0:00 — Where the Users Are
0:20 — The BNB & TRON Dominance
0:45 — Solana vs. NEAR: The Mid-Tier Race
1:10 — The Sei Warning: Usage vs. Price
1:35 — What to Watch Next

Connect with DeFi Planet:
🌐 Website: https://defi-planet.com/
🐦 Twitter/X: https://x.com/PlanetDefi

#CryptoAnalysis #Layer1 #DeFiPlanet #BNB #Solana #Tron #NearProtocol #Altcoins #BlockchainAdoption #FinancialEducation

asr.full_text: Ethereum is the big name, but the leaderboard for daily users looks a lot different this month. Let's dive in. BNB chain is leading with over 4 million users, followed by Tron, NIA and Solana. Even SEI is seeing over a million active addresses. NIA is fighting for its footing, showing some interesting patterns as it tries to build momentum. But users don't always mean price. Take SEI. Its price is still struggling to keep up with its massive traffic, Meanwhile BNB is building strength for a potential climb toward new highs and TRON is showing a very steady pattern that could lead to a breakout. Solana is also fighting hard to get back over that $100 milestone as momentum builds. At the end of the day, it's all about finding that balance between a busy network and a strong money flow. Do you follow the crowd or watch where the money is moving? Let me know below. Visit DEFIPlanet.com or follow us on our socials to stay ahead. Disclaimer this video is for informational purposes and is not financial advice. crypto markets are highly volatile do your own research and consult a professional before investing
